source: González Riga et al. 2018, Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 184: 136-181, Fig. 28: time-calibrated titanosaur tree with geographical distribution; rectangular, root left, tips right, a Cretaceous stage strip across the top, coloured range bars by continent, a pink box behind Lognkosauria, node circles and a sauropod silhouette. names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names
